conclusion: Up to 44 CGG: normal and meiotically stable.
45 to 54 CGG: intermediate. The carrier is not at risk, but the allele may be unstable in transmission. This 10-wide zone is where a caller's confidence interval most often straddles a boundary.

55 to 200 CGG: premutation. Risk of FXTAS and, in females, FXPOI; the allele may expand to a full mutation when maternally transmitted, and the expansion risk depends on the AGG interruption pattern this table cannot state.
Above 200 CGG: full mutation. FMR1 is methylated and silenced; fragile X syndrome.
No CGG repeat count was supplied. Withhold: an unmeasured tract is not a normal one.
